arthasJar.title: arthas-boot.jar
arthasJar.description: Absolute path to arthas-boot.jar. Set it and Run opens an Arthas terminal against the target PID; leave it empty and Run only copies the command, for a session you already have.

targetPid.title: Target JVM PID
targetPid.description: The PID arthas-boot attaches to non-interactively. Refresh the list in the panel to find it.

depth.title: Default depth (-x)
depth.description: How deep the result is expanded. 1 prints the summary, 3 prints nested objects.

count.title: Default count (-n)
count.description: How many invocations are recorded before watch / trace / stack / tt return.

monitorCount.title: Monitor periods (-n)
monitorCount.description: How many reporting periods monitor runs for.

monitorInterval.title: Monitor cycle (--cycle, seconds)
monitorInterval.description: The length of one reporting period. 120 is the interval monitor uses when it is not told one.

verbose.title: Print condition results (-v)
verbose.description: Also print whether the condition matched, for every invocation seen — useful while writing a condition.

condition.title: Start with '1==1'
condition.description: Fill in the placeholder condition. It always matches, so the command works before you write a real one.

skipJdkMethod.title: Hide JDK frames in trace
skipJdkMethod.description: Off (the default) passes --skipJDKMethod false, which shows the whole path including JDK classes — usually what you want when reading a call chain.

springContext.title: Spring context expression
springContext.description: The OGNL expression that yields the Spring ApplicationContext. @applicationContextProvider@context works when the app exposes one; otherwise read the environment through vmtool.

value.title: Field write value
value.description: The value field commands write. Empty means the target field's type decides: 0, false, "" or null.

level.title: Log level
level.description: trace, debug, info, warn or error. The panel offers the same five as a list.

event.title: Profiler event
event.description: cpu, alloc, lock, wall or itimer. cpu samples on-CPU time; wall also counts waiting.

format.title: Profiler output format
format.description: html (a flame graph you can open in a browser), jfr, collapsed or flat.

duration.title: Profiler duration (seconds)
duration.description: How long to sample before writing the file. 0 or less means sample until stopped.
